paragraphs: Welcome to my personal portfolio repository! This project serves as a showcase of my skills, projects, and educational background. It is built from scratch with a focus on clean, modern design and robust multi-language support.
features: Multi-Language Support: Fully translated into English (en), Traditional Chinese (zh), and Japanese (jp), with a custom-styled dropdown selector for seamless switching.
Light & Dark Modes: Complete theme support with smooth transitions, automatically adjusting based on the user's preference or toggled manually via a custom moon/sun icon switch.
Responsive Design: Built using modern CSS Grid and Flexbox to ensure a perfect layout across desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.
Minimalist & Modern Aesthetic: Features a custom "physical monitor frame" border effect, glassmorphic navigation bar, subtle hover micro-animations on cards, and coordinated color themes.
Zero Dependencies: Built entirely with plain HTML5, CSS3, and Vanilla JavaScript—no heavy frameworks or external libraries.
